name: 27-background-repeat-size
css: body { margin: 0; padding: 0; font-family: "builtin_song"; font-size: 17px; } .norep, .rx, .cov, .con { height: 64px; border: 1px solid #999; margin: 8px 0; background-image: url("data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAABAAAAAQCAIAAACQkWg2AAAAIklEQVR4nGM0TjvDQApgIkk1w6gG4gATkergYFQDMYBkDQB2OQGFVVAHNQAAAABJRU5ErkJggg=="); font-size: 12px; } .norep { background-repeat: no-repeat; background-position: right bottom; background-size: 20px 20px; } .rx { background-repeat: repeat-x; background-size: 12px 12px; } .cov { background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: cover; } .con { background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: contain; background-position: center center; }
html:
no-repeat + 20px 尺寸 + 右下定位
repeat-x 横向平铺 12px
cover 铺满
contain 居中
